research_question: Can Kernal reproduce modern Linux readiness/event descriptor semantics without lost wakeups, duplicate delivery or descriptor-generation leaks?
negative_controls: closed or stale-generation descriptors must never become ready through a reused FD number
edge/oneshot semantics must not lose required wakeups or duplicate one-shot delivery
invalid FD and unsupported flag combinations must return explicit Linux-compatible errors

repetition_policy.timing_metrics: report distribution and variance across declared readiness/event workloads

promotion_rule.to_measured: exact-SHA executed evidence must cover epoll/eventfd/timerfd/signalfd/inotify/memfd/pidfd declared surfaces and hard-zero negatives
promotion_rule.to_replicated: independent reproduction of the same fixture set is required
